ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT "Agreement"), made as of the 19ih day of April, 2013, by and between NEW COVENANT FAITH AND MIRACLE ARENA, INC., a New York religious corporation having an address at 1175 Boston Road, Bronx, New York 10456 ("Owner"), and COMMON GROUND COMMUNITY II HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND CORPORATION, a New York 10018 (*Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter individually referred to. WITNESSETH: thereon,in theCounty of theBronx,City andStateofNewYork,generallyknownby thestreet addressof 1185BostonRoad,a.k.a.1167-1185BostonRoad,Bronx,NewYork,designatedas Lot 43 in Block 2614 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the“Tax Map") and more herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Land,”" said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein referred to as the “Owner Building,” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the County of the Bronx,City and State of New York,generally known by the street address of 1191 Boston Road, Bronx, New York designated as Lot 38 in Block 2614 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein referred to as the“Developer Land," said buildings andimprovements,together withanyfuturereplacementsthereofpermittedpursuant tothe provisions of this Agreement, including the construction of a new building, being herein referred hereincollectively referred to as·the"Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than may be utilized on the Owner Parcel, pursuant to the ZoningResolution,if the OwnerParcelwere tobe treated as a separate and independent zoning lot, and that theParties desire to make 49,616 squarefeet of the excess floor area attributed to the Owner Land (the“Transferable Development Rights") available for transfer to Developer for incorporation into the Developer Building by utilizing that procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution to combine the Owner Land and the Developer Land into a single “zoning lot", and Owner is willing to make all such Transferable Development Rights available to Developerinperpetuity;

WHEREAS, theParties hereto aresimultaneouslyherewith executing (i) aDeclaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions(the“Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in the definition of the term“zoning lot"in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot comprised of the Owner Land and the Developer Land (such single zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement,is herein referred to as the“Merged Zoning Lot”and is more particularly described on Exhibit “C" annexed hereto and made a part hereof), and (ii) such other agreements, easements andlicenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of.theParties as set forth herein (the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to asthe“ZoningDocuments"); WHEREAS, the Parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the Parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. Certain Definitions. As used herein: A. "Applicant”shall mean thePartywho is an applicant for a building or alteration B.“"Bonus Development Rights" shall mean any bonus. floor area above the base floor area and other development rights pertaining to any portion of a zoning lot that may become available for inclusion in a building constructed thereon pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (i) by reason of the provision of an amenity or public benefit whether or not such amenity or public benefit is located on the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation Section 23-90 et seq. thereof, or (i) as the result of a transfer of Development Rights from a landmark or listed theater pursuant to Section 74-79 or other applicable section of the Zoning Resolution, as the same may be amended.Bonus Development Rights shall specifically include the right to utilize the lot area of the Owner Parcel in calculating anybonusfloor area. C.“Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or other day on which commercial banks are authorized tobe closed in the State of NewYork.
